allocation_policy.content: Intercompany Allocation Policy v4.2. (1) Allocate each service's Total Cost across active intercompany subsidiaries strictly in proportion to that service's driver value. (2) Round final per-subsidiary amounts to the nearest cent; absorb any rounding residual in the largest allocation so each service ties exactly to its Total Cost. (3) Materiality: flag any single allocation that exceeds $250,000 or any subsidiary total exceeding $400,000 for senior review. (4) No invoice may be issued and no journal posted until the allocation package is approved by the FP&A manager and countersigned by Treasury.
